type.probe_2110.cfg.log_level.help: Container log verbosity. Default “Events”: notable facts (start/stop, format change, reconnection, fallback to a degraded path, an input appearing or disappearing) are ALWAYS written — after a failure the log must let you reconstruct the story, and raising the level afterwards recovers nothing. Periodic metrics (fps, counters) are NOT logged: they are already published on :8080. “Verbose” = a flamethrower, one line per frame, to be enabled only for the duration of a diagnosis (the Docker log is not rotated).
